class.name: ResolvedJoin
class.brief_description: What one accepted player sent to join, as the server wrote it down and sent it on to everyone else.
class.description: This is the roster entry that crosses the wire. The server builds one from the [member username] and the values a peer passed to [method Netw.join], and every peer receives it, which is how each of them learns who is in the game. A game rarely handles one. [method Netw.configure_join] hands the server a [NetwParticipant] instead, and [member NetwParticipant.join] is this frame behind it for the rare caller that wants the values exactly as they arrived. [method deserialize] reads bytes a remote peer wrote, and it rejects anything that does not spell a join rather than admitting a half-read one. [codeblock] # The session returns the join it accepted for a peer. var join := api.peer_get_accepted_join(peer_id) print(join.username, " joined as ", join.peer_id) [/codeblock]

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Reads a join from [param bytes], or [code]null[/code] when they do not spell one. [param bytes] arrive from a remote peer, so this rejects rather than trusting: bytes that are not a record, a record naming no [member peer_id] or [member username], and a [member peer_id] that is not a number all return [code]null[/code]. [member arg_values] is optional and takes its default, so a peer running an older build still sends a readable join.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Writes this join as the frame the server sends to every peer, which [method deserialize] reads back. Keys are [StringName], matching the frame a GDScript-era peer wrote and still reads.

members.member: Typed join args the session's registered handler receives after this join, empty when the peer named no join intent. Carries the [code]args[/code] passed to [method NetwMultiplayer.session_submit_join] and its kin.
The server peer id assigned to this player.
The player's display name. A session's join gate is what decides two peers may not hold one name, so this is unique only where that gate says it is.
